sentences.en: Today, I want to tell you about an interview with the country's top infectious disease expert, Dr. Anthony Fauci, conducted by my colleague, opinion columnist
sentences.zh: 今天，我想向大家介绍我同事、评论专栏作家卡拉·斯威舍在她的播客《Sway》中对美国顶级传染病专家安东尼·福奇博士进行的采访。

sentences.en: In the conversation, Kara asks Fauci about the politicization of the pandemic response, the potential origins of the virus, and the content of Fauci's newly
sentences.zh: 在对话中，卡拉询问了福奇关于疫情应对的政治化、病毒的潜在起源，以及福奇新近

sentences.en: In the past year and a half, Dr. Anthony Fauci has become a hero to some, including the owners of a deli in my neighborhood that sells a cocktail called the Fauci Pouchy.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年半里，安东尼·福奇博士对一些人来说成了英雄，包括我附近一家熟食店的老板，他们卖一种叫“福奇小袋”的鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: But he's become a villain to others, people who hang on his every word to discredit him and question his motivations.
sentences.zh: 但对另一些人来说，他成了恶棍，这些人对他说的每一句话都紧咬不放，试图抹黑他并质疑他的动机。

sentences.en: To them, he's Dr. Flip Flopchi, the leader of Fauciism.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，他是“反复无常的福奇博士”，是“福奇主义”的领袖。

sentences.en: Those types have gotten some fuel after BuzzFeed and The Washington Post published thousands of
sentences.zh: 在BuzzFeed和《华盛顿邮报》公布了数千封

sentences.en: Fauci's emails from the early days of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 福奇在疫情初期的电子邮件后，这些人更是火上浇油。

sentences.en: I find the emails mostly anodyne, but the right and conspiracy theorists are using them as more fodder, saying that Fauci lied about
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些邮件大多平淡无奇，但右翼分子和阴谋论者却把它们当作更多的谈资，声称福奇在

sentences.en: the need to wear masks and downplayed the Wuhan lab leak theory.
sentences.zh: 佩戴口罩的必要性上撒了谎，并淡化了武汉实验室泄漏理论。

sentences.en: To parse the politics from the science, I invite him to speak with me today.
sentences.zh: 为了从科学中理清政治因素，我今天邀请他与我交谈。

sentences.en: Dr. Fauci, welcome to Sway.
sentences.zh: 福奇博士，欢迎来到《Sway》。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's good to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起。

sentences.en: So let's just start with the news, the most recent thing, which is the lab leak theory, which posits that COVID-19 originated in a lab in Wuhan, China.
sentences.zh: 那么我们先从新闻说起，最近的一件事，就是实验室泄漏理论，该理论认为COVID-19起源于中国武汉的一个实验室。

sentences.en: The theory has become deeply politicized, muddled with former President Trump's anti-China and really anti-Chinese rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 这一理论已经变得高度政治化，与前总统特朗普的反华和真正的排华言论混杂在一起。

sentences.en: It came a thing that some on the right glommed onto and the left kind of dismissed outright.
sentences.zh: 它成了右翼某些人紧抓不放，而左翼则直接否定的一件事。

sentences.en: In April of last year, President Trump announced that his administration had evidence that proves the lab leak theory, but never put it forth.
sentences.zh: 去年四月，特朗普总统宣布他的政府有证据证明实验室泄漏理论，但从未将其公之于众。

sentences.en: Did you see any evidence?
sentences.zh: 你看到过任何证据吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I haven't seen it because I'm not sure it exists.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我没见过，因为我不确定它是否存在。

sentences.en: What we're seeing right now is a major increase in incidents of interest, that is, of tweeting, of speculation, but no real increase in definitive data or evidence whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到的是人们对相关事件的兴趣大幅增加，也就是推特上的讨论和猜测，但并没有任何确凿的数据或证据增加。

sentences.en: And I think that the people who look carefully at that really come away with saying, well, what is different now than what was known or being said a year ago?
sentences.zh: 我认为那些仔细研究过的人，最终都会得出结论：现在和一年前所知或所说的有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: You know, there is this so-called intelligence
sentences.zh: 你知道，有这种所谓的“情报”

sentences.en: that three members of the Wuhan lab were ill, requiring hospitalization.
sentences.zh: 说武汉实验室有三名成员生病，需要住院治疗。

sentences.en: And I really wonder what the strength of that intelligence is, what the confidence in it is.
sentences.zh: 我真的很怀疑这份情报的力度，以及对它的信心有多大。

sentences.en: It certainly has gotten bantered around.
sentences.zh: 它确实被到处议论。

sentences.en: And I have said that if the intelligence is firm and real, then you should make sure we find out what the health records of those sick people are.
sentences.zh: 我说过，如果情报是确凿真实的，那么你应该确保我们查清那些病人的健康记录。

sentences.en: But if it's very weak, flimsy intelligence, then there's nothing there.
sentences.zh: 但如果这是非常薄弱、站不住脚的情报，那就没什么可说的了。

sentences.en: I always keep an open mind.
sentences.zh: 我总是保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: I feel, as do the overwhelming majority of scientists who have knowledge of virology and knowledge of evolutionary
sentences.zh: 我觉得，正如绝大多数具备病毒学和进化生物学知识的科学家所认为的那样，

sentences.en: biology, that the most likely explanation for this is a natural leap from an animal reservoir to a human.
sentences.zh: 最可能的解释是病毒从动物宿主自然跨越到人类。

sentences.en: A zoonotic leap.
sentences.zh: 一种人畜共患病的跨越。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: So what is the Biden administration now doing?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登政府现在在做什么？

sentences.en: Because one of it will require investigation.
sentences.zh: 因为其中一部分需要调查。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I'm really not sure, Cara, exactly, to be quite honest with you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，老实说，卡拉，我真的不确定。

sentences.en: I don't know exactly what the nature of that intelligence, because the president has asked
sentences.zh: 我不知道那种情报的性质究竟是什么，因为总统已经要求

sentences.en: the intelligence community to look into this and given them 90 days to come back with information.
sentences.zh: 情报界对此进行调查，并给了他们90天的时间来反馈信息。

sentences.en: I mean, it's important.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这很重要。

sentences.en: I support what the president's done.
sentences.zh: 我支持总统所做的事情。

sentences.en: And we all do, because we all want to find out really what the origins were.
sentences.zh: 我们都支持，因为我们都想真正查明起源是什么。

sentences.en: But again, I get back to saying, if you talk to the scientists with knowledge about viruses, because we hear a lot of people making statements that are really completely debunked.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，如果和了解病毒的科学家交谈，因为我们听到很多人发表的言论其实已经被完全驳斥了。

sentences.en: Well, there's a lot of expert virologists on Twitter, but I'm teasing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，推特上有很多病毒学专家，我是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: But there's some reputable scientists, including epidemiologists like Dr. Ralph Baric and Dr.
sentences.zh: 但确实有一些受人尊敬的科学家，包括像拉尔夫·巴里克博士和

sentences.en: Mark Lipsish, seem to think it's possible it originated in a lab, or at least they think the theory is worth checking out, which is what you're saying here.
sentences.zh: 马克·利普西奇博士这样的流行病学家，似乎认为它有可能起源于实验室，或者至少他们认为这个理论值得一查，这正是你在这里所说的。

sentences.en: But what makes you think the lab leak theory is improbable?
sentences.zh: 但你为什么认为实验室泄漏理论不太可能？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think if you look at the history of how viruses evolve, look at SARS-CoV-1, look at MERS, look at Ebola, we still haven't found the natural source of Ebola.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，如果你看看病毒进化的历史，看看SARS-CoV-1，看看MERS，看看埃博拉，我们至今还没有找到埃博拉的自然来源。

sentences.en: And that's been since 1976.
sentences.zh: 那可是从1976年就开始了。

sentences.en: So this is what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是会发生的情况。

sentences.en: Look at influenza.
sentences.zh: 看看流感。

sentences.en: Look at bird flu,
sentences.zh: 看看禽流感，

sentences.en: H5N1, H7N9, that jump species.
sentences.zh: H5N1，H7N9，它们跨越了物种。

sentences.en: This is a very, very natural thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常、非常自然的事情。

sentences.en: And if you look at the virus itself, again, I'm not an evolutionary virologist, but those who are, look at the virus and they say
sentences.zh: 如果你看看病毒本身，再说一次，我不是进化病毒学家，但那些专家观察病毒后说

sentences.en: it's absolutely, totally compatible with something that evolved from bat viruses because of the closeness to it.
sentences.zh: 它与从蝙蝠病毒进化而来的东西完全兼容，因为它们非常接近。

sentences.en: We don't have that extra link that's come in, but there's nothing they see in there that makes you think it was something that came from a lab.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有找到那个额外的环节，但他们没有在里面看到任何让你觉得它来自实验室的东西。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So you support the investigation into this, correct?
sentences.zh: 所以你支持对此进行调查，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, I think we should definitely try.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我们绝对应该尝试。

sentences.en: Indeed, I have said that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我已经说过了。

sentences.en: As a scientist, I have always kept an open mind about things until they were definitively proven.
sentences.zh: 作为一名科学家，在事情被最终证实之前，我总是保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: So if an investigation gets us closer to that, then I certainly am in favor of that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果调查能让我们更接近真相，那我当然支持。

sentences.en: The one thing that I feel we need to do, we've better make sure that any investigation includes people who have real
sentences.zh: 我感到我们需要做的一件事是，必须确保任何调查都包括真正具备相关

sentences.en: scientific knowledge about this and get the political aspects out of it.
sentences.zh: 科学知识的人，并排除政治因素。

sentences.en: And also there needs to be a combination of diplomacy together with scientific investigation together with, I guess I would call forensics.
sentences.zh: 此外，还需要将外交与科学调查以及我称之为法医调查结合起来。

sentences.en: They've all got to be together because if you go in in an accusatory way, you will put the
sentences.zh: 它们必须结合在一起，因为如果你以指责的方式介入，你会让

sentences.en: Well, they haven't been particularly forthcoming on lots of issues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在很多问题上一直都不太配合。

sentences.en: I mean, even when they're not hiding anything, they act that way.
sentences.zh: 我是说，即使他们没有隐瞒什么，他们表现出来的也是那样。

sentences.en: I mean, if you look at the first SARS in 2002, they were not particularly forthcoming in what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你看看2002年的第一次SARS，他们在发生的事情上就不太配合。

sentences.en: And what it was was proven of being a natural occurrence.
sentences.zh: 而事实证明那是一次自然发生的事件。

sentences.en: Yet if you look the way they acted early on, that's the nature of the way the Chinese, when they have something that goes on in their own country, they just act in a
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你看看他们早期的行为方式，这就是中国人的本性，当他们国内发生某些事情时，他们的表现就是

sentences.en: very put-offish way.
sentences.zh: 非常冷淡。

sentences.en: They don't, they're not forthcoming with information.
sentences.zh: 他们不提供信息。

sentences.en: Does that mean that they're really lying and hiding something?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着他们真的在撒谎和隐瞒什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.zh: 那么，武汉病毒研究所的顶级生物学家石正丽博士声称，在疫情爆发前，她的实验室从未持有任何新型冠状病毒的来源。

sentences.en: It's not entirely clear if that's the case.
sentences.zh: 目前还不完全清楚是否如此。

sentences.zh: 你相信她吗？

sentences.en: I don't know her.
sentences.zh: 我不认识她。

sentences.en: In fact, I've never met her.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我从未见过她。

sentences.en: But I talked to virologists who interact with her, and they say she's a scientist who's very talented, has a high degree of integrity,
sentences.zh: 但我与和她有互动的病毒学家交谈过，他们说她是一位非常有才华、具有高度诚信的科学家，

sentences.en: and is someone whose major purpose is to prevent outbreaks from occurring.
sentences.zh: 而且她的主要目的是防止疫情发生。

sentences.en: As a matter of fact, she is one of the investigators who discovered the ultimate connection of SARS-CoV-1 to the animal kingdom.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她是发现SARS-CoV-1与动物界最终联系的研究人员之一。

sentences.en: I don't think very many people recognize that.
sentences.zh: 我想没多少人意识到这一点。

sentences.en: And she is a member of the American Academy of Microbiology.
sentences.zh: 而且她是美国微生物学会的成员。

sentences.en: So she is a very well-recognized scientiSt.

sentences.en: So do you believe her on this?
sentences.zh: 那么你在这件事上相信她吗？

sentences.en: I mean, because they have pressures in China, and the government does shut things down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，因为他们在国内有压力，而且政府确实会封锁消息。

sentences.en: You know, Kara, I don't know her.
sentences.zh: 你知道，卡拉，我不认识她。

sentences.en: I can tell you from her reputation, her reputation would have people believe her.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，从她的声誉来看，她的声誉会让人们相信她。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And do you ever think we're going to find the source, given

sentences.zh: 这在我们国家已经被政治化了。

sentences.en: It's politicized here in this country.

sentences.en: You know, I hope so.

sentences.en: in bats and other animals that come into the wet market to finally see the connection.

sentences.en: Zuckerberg have added fuel to fire.

sentences.zh: 你是在嘲笑我吗？

sentences.zh: 我笑的原因是，卡拉，因为每一封邮件都可以用一种非常正常、非常无辜且完全光明正大的方式来解释。

sentences.en: Were you trying to get help with your Instagram?
sentences.zh: 你是想寻求关于Instagram的帮助吗？

sentences.zh: 当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I don't know who redacted that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我不知道是谁涂黑了那些内容。

sentences.en: When people ask for my emails, I don't look through my emails and say, okay, I'll give you this one and redact this.
sentences.zh: 当人们索要我的邮件时，我不会去翻看邮件然后说，好吧，这封给你，这封涂黑。

sentences.en: It's completely out of my control.
sentences.zh: 这完全不在我的控制范围内。

sentences.en: So you want to know what the email was really about?
sentences.zh: 所以你想知道那封邮件到底说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Hey, big scoop here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，大新闻来了。

sentences.en: We're going to go.
sentences.zh: 我们要开始了。

sentences.en: Mark said, hey, is there anything that we can do to help out to get the messages out, the right public health messages?
sentences.zh: 马克说，嘿，我们能做些什么来帮忙传达信息，传达正确的公共卫生信息吗？

sentences.en: I have a very important medium here in Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我在Facebook这里有一个非常重要的媒介。

sentences.en: Can I help?
sentences.zh: 我能帮上忙吗？

sentences.en: And as a matter of fact, if you guys don't have enough resources and money to do some of the things you want, just let us know.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你们没有足够的资源和资金来做你们想做的一些事情，尽管告诉我们。

sentences.en: It was about as friendly and innocent an email as you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 那封邮件的内容再友好、再无辜不过了。

sentences.en: So not about whether to censor speech related to COVID, anything else?
sentences.zh: 所以不是关于是否要审查与新冠或其他任何相关言论？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely 100%.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对百分之百不是。

sentences.en: And any thought of that is total conspiracy theory and total flight of fantasy.
sentences.zh: 任何那样的想法都是彻头彻尾的阴谋论和完全的幻想。

sentences.en: Did you sense that these emails were going to be released before they were published?
sentences.zh: 在这些邮件发布之前，你是否感觉到它们会被公开？

sentences.zh: 你知道，我实际上收到了太多关于各种事物的《信息自由法》（FOIA）请求。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just a big institution.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个很大的机构。

sentences.en: We're a very visible group.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个非常显眼的群体。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, I didn't know that there were thousands and thousands of emails that got sent out.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我甚至不知道有成千上万封邮件被发了出去。

sentences.en: I didn't even know that.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不知道这一点。

sentences.en: So I didn't get worried about it because I never, I didn't say anything in the email that I was worried about.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不担心，因为我从来没有，我在邮件里没说过任何让我担心的话。

sentences.en: But once I knew that it got out there and it was going to get very carefully scrutinized by very far right radical people who
sentences.zh: 但一旦我知道它流传出去，并且会被那些极右翼激进分子仔细审查，他们

sentences.zh: 显然是在试图抹黑我，这一点毫无疑问，那是政治性的。

sentences.en: It's clear.
sentences.zh: 很清楚。

sentences.en: It's anti-science and it's anti-me.

sentences.en: I said to myself, it is likely, I know, that you can pull out sentences from emails or take emails out of context or take an email that is perfectly innocent, followed up by an
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，我知道，很有可能有人会从邮件中摘取句子，或者断章取义，或者拿出一封完全无辜的邮件，后面跟着

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That is something that people are focusing on.
sentences.zh: 那是人们关注的一点。

sentences.en: And let me just be clear.
sentences.zh: 让我说清楚一点。

sentences.en: My brother, who's a doctor, said the same thing to me at that time, like probably it's not going to help and this and that.
sentences.zh: 我的兄弟，他也是一名医生，当时也对我说了同样的话，比如可能没什么用之类的。

sentences.en: And you should save them for healthcare workers, was his, he's an anesthesiologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该把口罩留给医护人员，这是他的观点，他是一名麻醉师。

sentences.zh: 那么事后看来，你是否担心当时应该在评论这些问题之前再等等？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Cara, allow me to explain that plus one other thing that gets thrown around by people
sentences.zh: 那么卡拉，请允许我解释一下，还有另一件事被那些人到处散布，

sentences.en: who all they want to do is give ad hominems and quite frankly, have no idea what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他们只会进行人身攻击，坦率地说，根本不知道自己在谈论什么。

sentences.en: Back early on, when we were talking about masks and whether you should wear masks, we're at a time that there were very, very few infections here.
sentences.zh: 早些时候，当我们讨论口罩以及是否应该戴口罩时，当时我们这里的感染人数非常非常少。

sentences.en: And there were three aspects that dictated that discussion.
sentences.zh: 有三个方面决定了那次讨论。

sentences.en: One, we were told right in the situation room that there would be a shortage of masks if everybody went out and bought a mask because people were going to buy N95s.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们在战情室里被告知，如果每个人都出去买口罩，就会出现口罩短缺，因为人们会去抢购N95口罩。

sentences.en: And given the personal protective equipment, we did not want to create a situation where healthcare providers who absolutely needed masks wouldn't get it.
sentences.zh: 考虑到个人防护装备，我们不想造成一种局面，即真正需要口罩的医疗服务提供者反而得不到口罩。

sentences.en: Point number two, at the time, there was no real evidence that masks worn outside of the setting of the hospital actually worked to protect you.

sentences.en: And number three, we did not know at the time that about half or maybe more of infections were transmitted by people who had no symptoMs. So those are three things.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们当时不知道大约一半甚至更多的感染是由没有症状的人传播的。所以这是三件事。

sentences.en: Hold on to that.
sentences.zh: 记住这一点。

sentences.en: At the time that I said to Sylvia that you don't necessarily need to wear a mask and where I even said publicly, you don't need to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 在我对西尔维娅说你不一定需要戴口罩，甚至我在公开场合说你不需要戴口罩的时候。

sentences.en: You know who agreed with me?
sentences.zh: 你知道谁同意我的观点吗？

sentences.en: The entire Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the CDC, and the Surgeon
sentences.zh: 整个美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC），以及美国卫生局

sentences.en: General of the United States.
sentences.zh: 局长。

sentences.en: Yet that is being fashioned as an anti-Fauci thing.
sentences.zh: 然而，这却被塑造成了一件反福奇的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, now let's fast forward.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在让我们快进。

sentences.en: What did we learn in the subsequent month or two when I changed and said everybody should wear a mask?
sentences.zh: 在接下来的那一两个月里，当我改变主意并说每个人都应该戴口罩时，我们学到了什么？

sentences.en: A, there was no shortage because we found out that cloth masks actually work.
sentences.zh: A，没有短缺，因为我们发现布口罩实际上是有用的。

sentences.en: Number two,
sentences.zh: 第二，

sentences.en: analyses that were published that showed for the first time that guess what?
sentences.zh: 发表的分析首次表明，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Outside of the hospital setting, masks actually work to protect you and to prevent you from spreading.
sentences.zh: 在医院环境之外，口罩确实能起到保护你并防止你传播病毒的作用。

sentences.en: And three, we learned to our horror that about 50% of the infections were being transmitted by people who didn't even know they were infected.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们惊恐地发现，大约50%的感染是由那些甚至不知道自己被感染的人传播的。

sentences.en: So that is the reason why I changed my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我改变主意的原因。

sentences.en: So the people who are giving the ad hominems are saying, ah, Fauci misled us.
sentences.zh: 所以那些进行人身攻击的人说，啊，福奇误导了我们。

sentences.en: First he said no mask, then he said mask.
sentences.zh: 起初他说不用口罩，后来他又说要戴口罩。

sentences.en: Well, let me give you a flash.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我告诉你一个事实。

sentences.en: That's the way science works.
sentences.zh: 科学就是这样运作的。

sentences.en: You work with the data you have at the time.
sentences.zh: 你根据当时掌握的数据进行工作。

sentences.en: It is essential as a scientist that you evolve your opinion and your recommendations based on the data as it evolves.
sentences.zh: 作为一名科学家，根据数据的发展演变来调整你的观点和建议是至关重要的。

sentences.en: That is the nature of science.
sentences.zh: 这就是科学的本质。

sentences.en: It is a self-correcting process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个自我纠正的过程。

sentences.en: And that's the reason why I say people who then criticize me about that are actually criticizing science.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我说那些批评我的人实际上是在批评科学。

sentences.en: It was not a change because they felt like flip-flopping.
sentences.zh: 这不是因为他们觉得我在反复无常而改变。

sentences.en: It was a change because the evidence changed.
sentences.zh: 这是因为证据变了，所以才改变。

sentences.en: The data changed.
sentences.zh: 数据变了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the things I was thinking about is that the idea of public health is things evolve, right?
sentences.zh: 我一直在想的一件事是，公共卫生的理念是随着事物的发展而演变的，对吧？

sentences.en: But that's impossible in this twitchy, noisy culture now.
sentences.zh: 但在现在这种神经质、嘈杂的文化中，这是不可能的。

sentences.en: Is there another way you're going to have to go through public health?
sentences.zh: 你还有其他方式来处理公共卫生问题吗？

sentences.en: Because the most part, people had trust in what you said.
sentences.zh: 因为在很大程度上，人们曾经信任你说的话。

sentences.en: And if you say, I made a mistake, or things have changed, people accepted it.
sentences.zh: 如果你说，我犯了一个错误，或者情况发生了变化，人们是接受的。

sentences.en: They don't accept it now.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们不接受了。

sentences.en: Do you think you can now these days be wrong in public health or be not have enough information?
sentences.zh: 你认为在当今的公共卫生领域，你还能犯错或者信息不足吗？

sentences.en: You can be wrong if you're dealing with information that it's evolving.
sentences.zh: 如果你处理的是不断演变的信息，你可能会犯错。

sentences.en: I mean, if all of a sudden I started to say that smoking is not deleterious to your health, that would be dead wrong because all the data show
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我突然开始说吸烟对你的健康没有危害，那将是完全错误的，因为所有数据都显示

sentences.en: it's highly deleterious to your health.
sentences.zh: 它对你的健康危害极大。

sentences.en: But when you're dealing with a rapidly evolving pandemic, things change.
sentences.zh: 但当你面对一场迅速演变的流行病时，情况会发生变化。

sentences.en: So it isn't a question of being wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是犯错的问题。

sentences.en: It's a question of going with the data as you have and being humble enough and flexible enough to change with the data.
sentences.zh: 这是一个根据现有数据行事，并保持足够谦逊和灵活以随数据变化的问题。

sentences.en: So if you want to say, was I wrong back then when I said, you don't necessarily need to wear a mask?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想问，我当时说你不一定需要戴口罩时，我错了吗？

sentences.en: Well, based on what we know now, that definitely was wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据我们现在所知，那绝对是错了。

sentences.en: But based on what we know then, it wasn't wrong.
sentences.zh: 但根据我们当时所知，那并没有错。

sentences.en: And when you're dealing with an evolving situation that has politics, it's even worse.
sentences.zh: 当你处理一个涉及政治的演变局势时，情况会更糟。

sentences.en: Well, politics clouds the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，政治让整件事变得模糊不清。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so obvious.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太明显了。

sentences.en: You know, obviously in this interview, you can't in any way take sides, but the nonsense that's going on now,
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然在这次采访中，你不能以任何方式偏袒任何一方，但现在发生的那些胡言乱语，

sentences.en: the stuff that's being thrown around, criminal charges, blood on your hands.
sentences.zh: 那些被到处散布的东西，刑事指控，手上沾满鲜血。

sentences.en: What in God's name are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 你在说什么鬼话？

sentences.en: Are you surprised?
sentences.zh: 你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: Did you think it was going to stop when President
sentences.zh: 你以为当特朗普总统

sentences.en: Trump left office?
sentences.zh: 离任时这一切就会停止吗？

sentences.en: Or did you imagine it would get worse?
sentences.zh: 还是你想象过情况会变得更糟？

sentences.en: No, I didn't think it was going to stop because the same people who are out there lying about other things, why should they stop lying now?
sentences.zh: 不，我没觉得它会停止，因为那些在其他事情上撒谎的人，他们现在为什么要停止撒谎呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 让我说清楚一点。

sentences.zh: 当你谈到使用人身攻击时，你对利用你的名字来指代威权控制或思想

sentences.zh: 控制，或者他们认为你在搞什么鬼名堂，有什么看法？

sentences.en: Cara, what I do is I'm a public health official and a scientist who's devoted my entire 50-year medical career, 40 of which have been in public
sentences.zh: 卡拉，我所做的是，我是一名公共卫生官员和科学家，我将我50年的医学职业生涯全部奉献给了公共

sentences.en: health, to saving lives and, in fact, saving millions of lives.
sentences.zh: 卫生事业，其中40年都在致力于拯救生命，事实上，拯救了数百万人的生命。

sentences.en: So what I do is I concentrate on my job.
sentences.zh: 所以我所做的是专注于我的工作。

sentences.en: And when I concentrate on my job, I put very little weight in the adulation and very little weight in the craziness of condemning me.
sentences.zh: 当我专注于工作时，我很少在意那些赞美，也很少在意那些谴责我的疯狂言论。

sentences.en: Now, the other thing is that it gets preposterous.
sentences.zh: 另外，这变得荒谬可笑。

sentences.en: And the thing that bothers you most of all is the impact it has on your family.
sentences.zh: 最让你困扰的是它对你家人的影响。

sentences.en: I mean, getting death threats and getting your daughters and your wife threatened with obscene notes and threatening notes is not fun.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，收到死亡威胁，收到威胁你女儿和妻子的淫秽信件和威胁信，这并不好玩。

sentences.en: So I can't say that doesn't bother me.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能说这不困扰我。

sentences.en: I mean, the more extreme they get, the more obvious how political it is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们越极端，就越明显地显示出这是多么政治化。

sentences.en: Like Fauci is like Hitler.

sentences.zh: 福奇手上沾满了鲜血。

sentences.en: Are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: I mean, anybody who is just thinking about this in a dispassionate way has got to say, what the heck are those people talking about?
sentences.zh: 我是说，任何冷静思考这件事的人都不得不问，那些人到底在胡说八道些什么？

sentences.en: Here's a guy whose entire life has been devoted to saving lives.
sentences.zh: 这是一个毕生致力于拯救生命的人。

sentences.en: And now you're telling me he's like Hitler.
sentences.zh: 现在你却告诉我他就像希特勒一样。

sentences.en: You know, come on, folks, get real.

sentences.en: When you are out there as a public face of these things in order to explain it to the public, is that too much of a cost for public health officials?
sentences.zh: 当您作为这些事务的公众形象向大众进行解释时，这对公共卫生官员来说代价是否太大了？

sentences.en: Well, I know several of my colleagues are now reticent to talk out about anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道我的几位同事现在对谈论任何事情都保持沉默。

sentences.en: Now, this is an organized, I mean, I'm telling you things that people with greater insight than I are convinced of,
sentences.zh: 这是一种有组织的，我是说，我告诉你的这些事情，是那些比我更有洞察力的人所确信的，

sentences.en: that this is an organized effort to be able to essentially discredit the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是一场旨在从根本上抹黑真相的有组织行动。

sentences.en: The truth has disappeared.
sentences.zh: 真相已经消失了。

sentences.en: And I mean, people who think that January 6th was a friendly visit to the gift shop at the Capitol?
sentences.zh: 我是说，那些认为1月6日国会大厦事件只是一次友好的礼品店参观的人？

sentences.en: I mean, come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: It's complete distortion of reality.
sentences.zh: 这是对现实的彻底扭曲。

sentences.en: So when you're saying it's an organized effort to discredit the truth, and especially about you, do you have proof that they're doing that?
sentences.zh: 所以当你说是为了抹黑真相而进行的有组织行动，尤其是针对你个人时，你有证据证明他们在这样做吗？

sentences.en: Do you just watching it?
sentences.zh: 还是你只是在观察？

sentences.en: No, I don't have any proof.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有任何证据。

sentences.en: No, I don't have any time.
sentences.zh: 不，我没时间管这个。

sentences.en: It just seems to me really rather strange that everyone says the same talking points.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得很奇怪，每个人说的论调都一模一样。

sentences.en: You have people who absolutely have no idea of what they're talking about with virology are talking about furing cleavage sites.
sentences.zh: 有些人对病毒学一窍不通，却在谈论弗林蛋白酶切位点。

sentences.en: Like, who gave you that talking point?
sentences.zh: 比如，是谁给了你这个论调？

sentences.en: You know, come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: I'm old enough to be around for the whole AIDS crisis and your incredible work related to it.
sentences.zh: 我经历过整个艾滋病危机，也见证了你与之相关的卓越工作。

sentences.en: But you vehemently disagreed with the Reagan administration during the AIDS epidemic, and they were quite slow to move with this more marginalized group of people.
sentences.zh: 但在艾滋病流行期间，你强烈反对里根政府，因为他们对这个边缘化群体采取行动的速度非常缓慢。

sentences.en: And then with Trump during COVID, how do you compare them?
sentences.zh: 那么在新冠疫情期间面对特朗普，你如何比较他们？

sentences.en: Because that was a political time.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个政治化的时期。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're very different.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们非常不同。

sentences.en: Tell me how.
sentences.zh: 告诉我怎么个不同法。

sentences.en: I mean, it's black and white.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这黑白分明。

sentences.en: I mean, back at the time during the Reagan administration, when he did not use the bully pulpit
sentences.zh: 我是说，在里根政府时期，虽然他没有像我希望的那样利用总统的职权

sentences.en: as much as I would have liked him to do, to call attention to an emerging outbreak and had people around him who clearly were homophobic.
sentences.zh: 来呼吁关注一场新出现的疫情，而且他身边的人显然有恐同倾向。

sentences.en: It was a tough situation.
sentences.zh: 那是一个艰难的局面。

sentences.en: It was by people who, even though I disagreed with what they were doing, they never really were completely violating the tenets of like the organization.
sentences.zh: 但这些人，尽管我不同意他们的做法，他们从未真正完全违背组织原则。

sentences.en: They had respect for government.
sentences.zh: 他们尊重政府。

sentences.en: They had respect for the Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们尊重国会。

sentences.en: They had respect for the judicial branch.
sentences.zh: 他们尊重司法部门。

sentences.en: I mean, it was government working.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那是政府在正常运作。

sentences.en: You could disagree with them, but it wasn't the complete whatever it is that's going on right now.
sentences.zh: 你可以不同意他们的观点，但这和现在发生的完全不可同日而语。

sentences.en: To me, that's scary for our democracy, quite frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这对我来说是对我们民主的威胁。

sentences.en: So in the larger picture, throughout the whole pandemic, the political divide has informed everything from mask wearing to vaccine hesitancy.
sentences.zh: 那么从大局来看，在整个疫情期间，政治分歧影响了一切，从佩戴口罩到疫苗犹豫。

sentences.en: Do you think this divide is surmountable, or have we gone too far?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种分歧是可以克服的，还是我们已经走得太远了？

sentences.en: What is your hope?
sentences.zh: 你的希望是什么？

sentences.en: Is it social media that has to be pulled back?
sentences.zh: 是必须限制社交媒体吗？

sentences.en: You know, I'm not sure how we're going to get out of this situation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不确定我们该如何走出这种困境。

sentences.en: I do know that social media can be a way of spreading important, positive information, but the junk that gets put on that
sentences.zh: 我确实知道社交媒体可以成为传播重要、积极信息的途径，但上面充斥的垃圾信息

sentences.en: is frightening because it's so distorted that you have people read it and they follow it.
sentences.zh: 令人恐惧，因为它们被严重扭曲，以至于人们读了之后就会盲从。

sentences.en: I understand people like it.
sentences.zh: 我理解人们喜欢它。

sentences.en: I don't have a Twitter account, so I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我没有推特账号，所以我不知道。

sentences.en: Do you use Facebook?
sentences.zh: 你用脸书吗？

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，不用。

sentences.en: I mean, you're talking to the wrong person when it comes to social media.
sentences.zh: 我是说，谈到社交媒体，你找错人了。

sentences.en: There's a lot about you on it, just so you know, just FYI.
sentences.zh: 顺便告诉你，上面有很多关于你的内容，仅供参考。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And so I hear.
sentences.zh: 我听说过。

sentences.en: I mean, sometimes they put it in front of me, but now I just don't even want to look at it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有时他们会把这些东西推到我面前，但现在我甚至不想再看了。

sentences.en: So for those of you who think you're affecting me with it, sorry, I'm not looking at it.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些认为这能影响我的人，抱歉，我根本不看。

sentences.en: I'm interested in your thoughts on medical disinformation on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我想听听你对脸书上医疗虚假信息的看法。

sentences.en: Mark is asking you what he can do.
sentences.zh: 马克在问你他能做些什么。

sentences.en: With this medical disinformation, what should the platforms be doing?
sentences.zh: 面对这些医疗虚假信息，平台应该怎么做？

sentences.en: You know, again, Cara, I will get criticized if I make recommendations for things outside of my area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 你知道，卡拉，如果我对非我专业领域的事情提出建议，我会受到批评。

sentences.en: I'll stick to the science.
sentences.zh: 我会坚持科学。

sentences.en: I'll stick to the public health.
sentences.zh: 我会坚持公共卫生。

sentences.en: I don't know how to correct misinformation on social media.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如何纠正社交媒体上的错误信息。

sentences.en: I wouldn't know how to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: I do think they need to do something more about it.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为他们需要对此采取更多行动。

sentences.en: It's a very difficult thing because they've been charged with running all of society and they're very bad at it.
sentences.zh: 这非常困难，因为他们被赋予了管理整个社会的重任，但他们做得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: So that's the problem we have is that they're incapable to the task, Facebook in particular.
sentences.zh: 所以我们面临的问题是，他们无法胜任这项任务，尤其是脸书。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what they should do, labels, fines, but they do stop people from getting the treatment they need.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们应该做什么，贴标签、罚款？但他们确实阻碍了人们获得所需的治疗。

sentences.en: But when you're talking about what's coming next, are you, there's something you're worried about that you're watching for next?
sentences.zh: 但当你谈到未来时，你是在担心什么，或者在关注什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, 20 years ago, people would ask me the same question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，20年前，人们也会问我同样的问题。

sentences.en: And my, if you go back over the records, which is easy to do, you would see that I consistently gave the same answer.
sentences.zh: 如果回顾记录，这很容易做到，你会发现我始终给出的答案是一样的。

sentences.en: And that is the emergence of a new virus, a respiratory born virus that would jump species from an animal host to a human that would have two characteristics.
sentences.zh: 那就是一种新病毒的出现，一种通过呼吸道传播的病毒，它会从动物宿主跨物种跳跃到人类身上，并具有两个特征。

sentences.en: One, it would be highly efficient in transmissibility through the respiratory route.
sentences.zh: 第一，它通过呼吸道传播的效率极高。

sentences.en: And two, it would have a very high degree of capability of morbidity and mortality for the human population.
sentences.zh: 第二，它对人类群体具有极高的致病性和致死率。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, we're living through my worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们正在经历我最可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: Well, do you have a worse than a worst nightmare?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有比最可怕的噩梦更糟糕的情况？

sentences.en: No, no, actually, right now, what I'm saying to myself is that if this happens now, which it is, that it could happen again.
sentences.zh: 不，不，事实上，我现在对自己说的是，如果这种情况现在发生了，而且确实发生了，它可能会再次发生。

sentences.en: And it could even possibly be worse.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能更糟。

sentences.en: This is an unusual virus because, you know, about a third to 40% of the people get no symptoms at all, yet it's capable of killing
sentences.zh: 这是一种不同寻常的病毒，因为你知道，大约三分之一到40%的人根本没有任何症状，但它却能杀死

sentences.en: 600,000 Americans.
sentences.zh: 60万美国人。

sentences.en: We've never had a situation like that where a virus that would be benign for almost half the people or 40% of the people and yet kill so many people.
sentences.zh: 我们从未遇到过这种情况，一种对近一半或40%的人来说是良性的病毒，却能杀死这么多人。

sentences.en: So the possibility that can occur in the future that you could get a pandemic that would be essentially more uniform in its deleterious effect.
sentences.zh: 所以未来有可能出现一种大流行病，其破坏性影响在本质上会更加均匀。

sentences.en: We have two ways of preparing.
sentences.zh: 我们有两种准备方式。

sentences.en: You've got to prepare at the global level, have universal standards of communication, of surveillance, of those kinds of things, diagnostic capabilities.
sentences.zh: 你必须在全球层面进行准备，建立通用的沟通、监测标准，以及诊断能力等。

sentences.en: And you've got to make an investment in science.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须在科学上进行投资。

sentences.en: The investment in science that we have made over decades allowed us to do what some people would have thought was impossible,
sentences.zh: 我们几十年来在科学上的投入，使我们能够做到一些人认为不可能的事情，

sentences.en: to go from the awareness of a new virus in January to a highly effective vaccine in December.
sentences.zh: 从1月份意识到一种新病毒，到12月份研制出高效疫苗。

sentences.en: And what about this vaccine technology, the use of mRNA, for example?
sentences.zh: 那么这种疫苗技术，比如mRNA的使用呢？

sentences.en: How close are we to the same technology for flu or HIV vaccines, cancer vaccines?
sentences.zh: 我们距离将同样的技术用于流感、艾滋病疫苗或癌症疫苗还有多远？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对可以。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对可以。

sentences.en: I mean, one of the positive, you know, the silver lining, if you want to call it that, of this is that we have been able to show the extraordinary power of certain vaccine
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果非要说有什么积极的一面，或者说一线希望的话，那就是我们已经能够展示出某些疫苗

sentences.en: platform technology.
sentences.zh: 平台技术的非凡力量。

sentences.en: For sure, it's already being pursued in the realm of HIV, in the realm of influenza, in the realm of a variety of other infectious diseases.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，它已经在艾滋病、流感以及其他各种传染病领域得到了应用。

sentences.en: So the technology that was spectacularly successful with SARS-CoV-2 is absolutely going to put us a step ahead with other infections.
sentences.zh: 所以，在SARS-CoV-2上取得巨大成功的技术，绝对会让我们在应对其他感染时领先一步。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So one last question.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题。

sentences.en: If you could go back to February 2020, what's one thing that you would change that you did right now, knowing what you know now?
sentences.zh: 如果你能回到2020年2月，以你现在的认知，你最想改变的一件事是什么？

sentences.en: And I know that's an easy thing to say, even not knowing what you know now.
sentences.zh: 我知道即使不知道现在所知道的一切，这也是一句容易说出口的话。

sentences.en: Well, no, knowing what I know now, Cara, back then, but I don't think it would have worked because I don't think I would have convinced anybody.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，卡拉，以我现在的认知回到那时，但我认为这行不通，因为我不认为我能说服任何人。

sentences.en: So let's go back to the first case that we recognized was January 21St. You know, there was a handful of cases, you know, as we got into earlier.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到我们确认的第一例病例，那是1月21日。你知道，在那之前还有少数病例。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That we didn't recognize.
sentences.zh: 我们当时没识别出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If we had said then, let's shut everything down.
sentences.zh: 如果我们当时说，让我们把一切都关停。

sentences.en: If I had said that, people would have looked at me like I was crazy.
sentences.zh: 如果我当时这么说了，人们会觉得我疯了。

sentences.en: Are you talking about shutting down the government when you've had 17 cases?
sentences.zh: 你是在说在只有17个病例的时候就关停政府吗？

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: But looking back at what if might have stopped this a bit, it would have been that.
sentences.zh: 但回顾过去，如果这能阻止疫情蔓延，那会是那个选择。

sentences.en: But that would have been unacceptable to society.
sentences.zh: 但这在当时是社会无法接受的。

sentences.en: Even now, when we have absolute proof that this virus has killed 600,000 Americans, we still have people that don't want to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 即使是现在，当我们有确凿证据表明这种病毒已经杀死了60万美国人时，仍然有人不想接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of my relatives.
sentences.zh: 我的一位亲戚就是这样。

sentences.en: It's very disturbing.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人不安。

sentences.en: I don't even know what to say at this point.
sentences.zh: 到了这个地步，我甚至不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: What do I say to this relative who doesn't, who's like, herd immunity, I'm not going to get sick.
sentences.zh: 我该对这位亲戚说什么呢？他觉得，群体免疫了，我就不会生病。

sentences.en: What do you say?
sentences.zh: 你会怎么说？

sentences.en: I mean, I think there's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想有很多人都是这样。

sentences.en: Well, let me be clear, Kara.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我说清楚，卡拉。

sentences.en: I believe that there are a lot of people who don't want to get vaccinated, that there's absolutely nothing wrong with them at all.
sentences.zh: 我相信有很多不想接种疫苗的人，他们本身并没有什么问题。

sentences.en: They just need more information.
sentences.zh: 他们只是需要更多信息。

sentences.en: So, you know, you get to herd immunity.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，你要达到群体免疫。

sentences.en: You know what the best way to get to herd immunity is?
sentences.zh: 你知道达到群体免疫最好的方法是什么吗？

sentences.en: Get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 去接种疫苗。
